description: 津波断層モデル(2)地殻変動量データ [tsunami and earthquakes] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 内閣府　日本海溝・千島海溝沿いの巨大地震モデル検討会. 内閣府の日本海溝・千島海溝沿いの巨大地震モデル検討会において検討を行った震度分布・浸水域等に係るデータです。 (2)地殻変動量データ 断層によるコサイスミックな地殻変動量（鉛直方向）のデータ 問い合わせの際には、問い合わせフォームの「ご意見、ご感想」記入欄の冒頭に【震度分布・浸水域等に係るデータに関する問い合... Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 内閣府　日本海溝・千島海溝沿いの巨大地震モデル検討会. Its tags are 北海道地方, 千島海溝, 千島海溝モデル, 日本海溝, 日本海溝モデル. It offers 8 resource(s) in pdf, zip. The portal shows 2024-10-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is the data owner's own terms of use (see the dataset page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
